title: parasenecio ianthophyllus
intro: Parasenecio ianthophyllus, commonly known as the "Purple-flowered Senecio", is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Parasenecio ianthophyllus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
